_note: Settings menu layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255. theme is handed to PopUI as is, so its keys keep PopUI's names.

background._note: The vertical gradient behind everything, top to bottom; the masks over the rows that scroll past the pane use the same colours.

pane._note: The left pane of settings: x, y is its top left; it ends bottom_margin above the screen's bottom. Rows: names at name_x, section headers at header_x (both from the pane's left); every control right-aligns control_right_inset from the pane's right edge.

controls._note: value_w reserves room right of a slider so its number stays clear of the scrollbar.

scrollbar._note: In the pane's right gutter: x_inset from the pane's right edge; the mouse grabs it within grab_margin on either side.

preview._note: The right pane: the focused setting's name and description. The description wraps desc_wrap_inset narrower than the pane's inside (the glyph box pads 25 px per side, so this keeps the right margin equal to the left one). hint_y and prompt_y are from the pane's bottom.
